title: Per-model site text (zoo/models/<name>/site.yaml)
description: The only hand-written model prose on the website. Numbers may appear only as {metric:<kind>.<name>} placeholders that resolve against the latest published release; `zoo site check` (rule F2 in checks.md) rejects free-standing numbers such as '0.72' or '8 s', while digits inside names such as 'M3 Pro' or 'jtbd-span-v1' are allowed.

share_line.description: One line on the preview image when the page is shared: what the model does and why it matters. No numbers and no {metric:…} placeholders (an image cannot carry the note that says what a number is measured against). If absent, the tagline is used and must meet the same rules (check B6).

audience.description: Who the model is for, at most 25 words (gate rule 17, site check D2).

differentiators.description: Three or four reasons to use the model, shown in the overview (feature 014): title at most 5 words, text at most 20 words (gate rule 17, site check D2). No release status: it is generated.

metrics.description: Metric-name prefix in the results JSON, e.g. latency_9k_chars_s

labels.description: Repository path of a JSON label file, read at the release tag

metric_cards.description: Headline figures of the quality layer (at most 4, feature 014); each card prints the value, what it is compared with and what it is measured against or on.
